_comment: S12 team montage. Institution order is client-specified: Nahariya first, Rambam second, then the rest. Edit `montage_order` to re-sequence; edit `hero` per institution to swap the chosen image.

galilee.name: Galilee Medical Center
galilee.note: Host institution. Photos expected from client.

bnaizion.name: Bnai Zion Medical Center
bnaizion.note: Cropped to the left two-thirds. That removes the emoji sticker and the patient entirely, leaving three gowned staff at the monitors with their backs to camera - clinically strong and fully anonymous. Replaces bnaizion_03, whose centre-frame Hebrew scrub label ('do not leave the operating theatre in this garment') was the sharpest text in the montage's warmest beat.

hadassah.name: Hadassah Medical Organization
hadassah.note: Replaces hadassah_02, a selfie in which the foreground man is cut through the skull by the right frame edge and shows wide-angle distortion that the push-in makes worse every second.

closing_slot._comment: Final 5s of S12, under the 'One goal.' card. Prefer a wide, many-people frame.
closing_slot.note: Swap to a Galilee wide shot once Nahariya photos arrive - closing on the host institution is the stronger edit.

held_back.reason: PATIENT FACE VISIBLE at frame left during a procedure. Staff consent does not cover a patient. Do not use as-is.
held_back.remedy: Tight crop to the right two-thirds (operators + monitors only), or obtain written patient consent, or drop.

held_back.reason: Chilli-pepper emoji sticker pasted over the patient area. Reads as an error on a lobby screen.
held_back.remedy: Resolved: now used with crop [0.0, 0.28, 0.66, 1.0], which excludes the sticker and the patient.

held_back.reason: Off-site social photo (restaurant). Warm, but breaks the clinical register of the section.
held_back.remedy: Usable if the client wants a human/social beat. Currently unused.

held_back.reason: Orange scrub label, Hebrew, dead centre and fully legible: 'do not leave the operating theatre in this garment'. A laundry rule as the sharpest text in the film's warmest beat.
held_back.remedy: Crop it out, or supply a different Bnai Zion photograph.

held_back.reason: Foreground subject cut through the skull by the right frame edge; wide-angle facial distortion.
held_back.remedy: Usable if re-anchored and held at lower zoom. Currently unused.

review_notes: Employee ID badges are legible in several frames at 1080p. scripts/montage.py applies no blurring - decide per photo whether badge detail needs softening before final delivery.
hadassah_03 carries a Hebrew unit sign in frame. Brief specifies English-only on-screen text; in-photo signage is a grey area - flagged, not blocked.
_montage_casting: Only institutions with an existing `hero` are cast; the 20s before the closing slot is shared between them. Institutions awaiting photographs are skipped rather than filling screen time with an empty reserved card, and the montage re-expands automatically once a hero is set.
